speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A very good piece of it, and the ear saved for the end, and the whole room made to wait. That is his mouth. Too many of my joints in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once more, the same road, slower, as he would hold them on the turf. Still mine. I can hear the ink.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The queen stays where she is. On top of this, when I get to her. Not tonight.
